The mention of 'llama' and 'safetensors' points to significant developments in large language models (LLMs).

stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.

stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in generative AI tasks.
The model is associated with key technologies like transformers and safetensors, placing it in the mainstream LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
It utilizes standard ML formats like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted on Apple Silicon when run through Ollama 0.31.
The speed improvement is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance boost results in faster response times and reduced memory usage for LLMs.
The updated engine also contributes to higher quality outputs from the language models.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, has integrated support for MLX.
This integration enables faster performance when running Ollama specifically on Apple Silicon hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview release, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, ensuring all processing runs directly on the user's device.
The core value proposition is providing private, on-device AI assistance for coding tasks.

stories.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Meta is disabling an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts.
The feature raised significant backlash because it used content from public accounts without explicit owner permission.
This action highlights growing industry concerns regarding AI usage rights and consent in generative media.

stories.title: The FCC is cracking down on DJI tech that dodged the foreign drone ban
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: The FCC is actively cracking down on entities suspected of circumventing the US foreign drone ban.
The crackdown targets companies like Xtra and Skyrover, which allegedly facilitate the entry of DJI technology into the US.
This signals increased regulatory scrutiny over the distribution and compliance of foreign drone technology in the US market.

stories.title: Quantum error correction can constantly recalibrate a processor
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Quantum error correction is being advanced by integrating reinforcement learning.
The core mechanism involves using error information to dynamically adjust processor control algorithms.
This represents a significant step toward building stable and functional quantum processors.

stories.title: Ransomware negotiator hired to represent victims was working for the attackers
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A ransomware negotiator was found to be working for the attackers, betraying the victims.
The individual was sentenced to six years in prison for his actions.
The story highlights the severe risks and ethical compromises within the cybercrime negotiation space.

stories.title: AUTOPILOT VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Incident-Centric Dashcam Understanding
stories.author: Jugal Kalita
bullet_points: Introduces AUTOPILOT-VQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for incident-centric visual question answering in dashcam video understanding.
Addresses a critical gap in current research: reliably evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for reasoning about safety-critical driving incidents.
Leverages recent advancements in VLMs and LLMs to push the boundaries of autonomous driving perception and safety assessment.

stories.title: The Illusion of Equivalency: Statistical Characterization of Quantization Effects in LLMs
stories.author: Carson K. Leung
bullet_points: Traditional LLM evaluation (accuracy/perplexity) is insufficient for assessing quantization effects.
The paper introduces 'correctness agreement,' a new decision-level metric to measure behavioral changes post-quantization.
This research addresses a critical deployment challenge by providing a more robust evaluation method for resource-constrained LLMs.

stories.title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
stories.author: Davis Rempe
bullet_points: Introduces ARDY, a new autoregressive diffusion model designed for real-time 3D human motion generation.
Addresses the critical gap between high-fidelity, controllable offline motion generation and fast, interactive online synthesis.
Aims to enable complex, context-aware motion generation necessary for applications like robotics and interactive simulations.

stories.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
stories.author: Xihui Liu
bullet_points: Introduces UniClawBench, a new universal benchmark designed to evaluate proactive AI agents.
Addresses limitations in current benchmarks, which often use sandboxed environments and single-turn evaluation.
Aims to provide a more robust evaluation framework for real-world, complex tasks involving LLMs and multimodal models.

stories.title: WebSwarm: Recursive Multi-Agent Orchestration for Deep-and-Wide Web Search
stories.author: Zhicheng Dou
bullet_points: WebSwarm introduces a recursive multi-agent orchestration framework to overcome limitations in LLM-based web search.
The system addresses the constraint of single ReAct agents being limited by trajectory length and context window for deep/wide searches.
It aims to improve upon existing multi-agent systems by specifically enhancing recursive search depth and coverage.

stories.title: UltraX: Refining Pre-Training Data at Scale with Adaptive Programmatic Editing
stories.author: Zhiyuan Liu
bullet_points: The paper addresses the diminishing returns of scaling laws as available training data nears its limit.
It proposes 'UltraX,' a method for refining pre-training data at scale using adaptive programmatic editing.
UltraX aims to overcome limitations in existing data refinement techniques, such as the rigidity of rule-based approaches.

stories.title: Nvidia, CoreWeave, and Nebius: Inside the Circular Financing of the GPU Boom
stories.author: adletbalzhanov
bullet_points: Examines the financial mechanics driving the current GPU boom.
Focuses on the circular financing models involving major players like Nvidia, CoreWeave, and Nebius.
Highlights the complex capital flow supporting the massive demand for AI/ML hardware.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces significant performance improvements.
Enhanced GGUF model compatibility is now available via llama.cpp integration.
The update broadens model support across various hardware, complementing the MLX engine on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, offering an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The new feature set also enables web search capabilities within the Claude Code environment.
This suggests an enhancement in the complexity and capability of AI agents managed via Ollama.

stories.title: China recovered its first reusable rocket and showed a new way to do it
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: China has successfully recovered its first reusable rocket.
The recovery demonstrated a new methodology for achieving reusability.
The effort is viewed as an attempt to replicate successful technologies pioneered by SpaceX.

stories.title: Firmware update bricks Hue Bridge Pro devices; Philips gives free replacements
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: A firmware update has caused Hue Bridge Pro devices to become unusable (bricked).
Philips is providing free replacement units to affected customers.
Users will need to reconfigure all their smart lighting settings after receiving replacements.

stories.title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
stories.author: Hongsheng Li
bullet_points: Introduces OpenCoF, a new approach to enabling reasoning within video generation models.
Proposes Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning as a temporal alternative to traditional Chain-of-Thought (CoT) in video generation.
Highlights the current limitation of existing models due to general training corpora and lack of dedicated CoF supervision.

stories.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
stories.author: Xue Yang
bullet_points: Introduces IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a new benchmark designed to test AI's ability to reason about scientific lineage.
Addresses the gap in current AI evaluation by modeling scientific ideas as having an 'inheritance structure,' similar to biological genomes.
Focuses on benchmarking both scientific lineage reasoning and the generation of ideas grounded in prior work.

stories.title: Using AI-based Learning Assistants in Higher Education: A Large-Scale Descriptive Analysis
stories.author: Valerie Heckel
bullet_points: The study provides a large-scale, objective analysis of AI learning assistant usage (Syntea) in higher education.
It analyzes usage patterns across diverse student demographics, including gender, age, and degree.
The research addresses a gap in existing literature by moving beyond small samples and self-reported survey data.

stories.title: Validity of LLMs as data annotators: AMALIA on authority
stories.author: Manuel Pita
bullet_points: The paper introduces AMALIA, a publicly funded 9B-parameter LLM specifically for European Portuguese.
AMALIA shows competitive agreement with human coders on tasks like defining the moral foundation of authority.
The research critically notes that high agreement only proves reliability, not the true validity of LLMs as annotators for complex theoretical constructs.

stories.title: Pose-to-Biomechanics: Bridging 3D Human Pose Estimation and Biomechanical Attribute Prediction
stories.author: Kevin Desai
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap where 3D human pose estimation focuses on geometric accuracy rather than biomechanical attributes.
A new lightweight temporal transformer, 'BioModule,' is proposed to bridge the gap between pose estimation and biomechanical prediction.
The application has high relevance across fields like rehabilitation, sports science, and clinical movement analysis.

stories.title: Score Accuracy Along the Forward Diffusion Does Not Certify Numerical Stability in Diffusion Sampling
stories.author: Yiwei Zhou
bullet_points: The paper investigates the relationship between forward diffusion marginal error and the numerical stability of the learned reverse-time sampling process.
It demonstrates that achieving small $L^2$ error in the forward marginals does not guarantee numerical stability in the discrete reverse-time sampler.
The research constructs a smooth score field that is nearly exact in path-space total variation while maintaining small forward-marginal error.

stories.title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
stories.author: Shiwei Liu
bullet_points: SLORR introduces a new technique for in-training low-rank regularization to improve neural network compressibility.
It addresses limitations of existing methods, such as the need for SVDs of large matrices or architectural modifications.
The proposed method is highlighted as being simple, stateless, and efficient.

stories.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
stories.author: Dominik Moritz
bullet_points: The research focuses on leveraging the internal k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph constructed by UMAP, rather than just its final low-dimensional embedding.
This internal graph preserves the data manifold structure in the original high-dimensional space, avoiding projection distortion.
Applying standard graph algorithms to this unutilized graph enhances data sensemaking capabilities.

stories.title: Super Weights in LLMs and the Failure of Selective Training
stories.author: Akarsha Sehwag
bullet_points: Identifies 'Super Weights' in LLMs—individual parameters critical for model performance.
Challenges the assumption that Super Weights are universally critical across all LLMs.
Demonstrates that training or pruning these identified Super Weights can severely degrade model accuracy.

stories.title: Pose-to-Biomechanics: Bridging 3D Human Pose Estimation and Biomechanical Attribute Prediction
stories.author: Kevin Desai
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap where 3D human pose estimation focuses on geometry, but real-world applications need biomechanical data.
A new lightweight temporal transformer, 'BioModule,' is proposed to bridge 3D pose estimation with biomechanical attribute prediction.
The technology has relevance across fields like rehabilitation, sports science, and clinical movement analysis.

stories.title: Latent Memory Palace: Reasoning for Control as Autoregressive Variational Inference
stories.author: Abhishek Gupta
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of transferring language model reasoning capabilities to continuous control policies.
Proposes 'Latent Memory Palace' using Autoregressive Variational Inference to organize information for control.
Aims to bridge the gap between high-level language reasoning and low-level, granular spatial/motor control.

stories.title: LTM: Large-scale Terrain Model for Wildfire-prone Landscapes
stories.author: Barath Raghavan
bullet_points: Proposes LTM, a large-scale terrain model designed for wildfire-prone landscapes.
Addresses limitations of current methods: LiDAR is expensive/infrequent, while image-based methods struggle with sparse features.
Introduces a multi-modal reconstruction framework to improve terrain mapping accuracy for emergency response.

stories.title: Validity of LLMs as data annotators: AMALIA on authority
stories.author: Manuel Pita
bullet_points: Introduces AMALIA, a publicly funded 9B-parameter LLM specifically for European Portuguese.
The model shows competitive agreement with human coders on tasks like measuring the moral foundation of authority.
The research critically notes that high agreement (reliability) does not guarantee validity for complex theoretical constructs.

stories.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
stories.author: Zhuokai Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses 'behavioral state decay' in long-horizon AI tasks where crucial state information gets lost in growing trajectories.
Proposes treating memory not as passive retrieval, but as an active intervention mechanism for decision-making.
Focuses on enabling agents to surface and utilize scattered, decision-relevant facts (e.g., environment facts, prior attempts) over long time scales.

stories.title: Do You Need a Frontier Model as a Citation Verifier? Benchmarking Rubric LLMs for Deep-Research Source Attribution
stories.author: Kevin Paul
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical need to benchmark LLM judges used as reward models in reinforcement learning systems.
It focuses specifically on citation quality in deep-research systems, where LLMs must ground claims with cited sources.
The research aims to determine the required capability and potential bias of LLMs when evaluating structured citation rubrics.

stories.title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
stories.author: Jyh-Shing Roger Jang
bullet_points: Introduces 'DominoTree,' a new method for conditional tree-structured drafting in speculative decoding.
Addresses a limitation of existing drafters (like DFlash) by incorporating a GRU-based causal correction for path-dependent token distributions.
Aims to improve LLM inference speed by enhancing the accuracy and structure of the draft tokens used in speculative decoding.

stories.title: The complexities of patient-centred conversational artificial intelligence
stories.author: Jonathan Amar
bullet_points: The study addresses a critical gap in health chatbot development: the reliance on simulated patients for testing.
Analysis of 2,053 real patient-chatbot conversations revealed significant variability in communication patterns and emotional expression among users.
Researchers developed a sophisticated patient simulator capable of modeling clinical content, emotional state, conversational strategy, and communication style.

stories.title: It Takes a MAESTRO To Prune Bad Experts
stories.author: Tanmoy Chakraborty
bullet_points: Addresses the deployment bottleneck in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where full expert banks remain in memory.
Identifies a limitation in existing pruning methods, which are designed for dense transformers and ignore MoE routing interdependence.
Introduces MAESTRO, a new technique designed to intelligently prune 'bad experts' in sparsely-activated MoE models.

stories.title: Postgres rewritten in Rust, now passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests
stories.author: github.com via Vaelatern
bullet_points: PostgreSQL has been successfully rewritten in the Rust programming language.
The Rust implementation has achieved 100% pass rate on the original Postgres regression tests.
This represents a significant effort in modernizing a core database technology using a memory-safe language.
